rejected.rationale: Hold this individual status. Pega can mean sticking/attaching or placing against something; this app has an independent attachment relation in addition to placed/not-placed. I cannot confidently certify Mapega as the unqualified placement status without implying attachment. The existing error phrase is not independent approval of this new status.

Hold together with the positive placement status. Ti mapega may be understood as not attached, whereas an image can be placed without an attachment. A reliable distinction is needed before replacing fallback; this is a bounded ambiguity, not a proven defect in every use of pega.

Seenu is an existing project term but I cannot confidently endorse its noun use for a selected-page preview from current evidence. The reviewed primary terminology does not resolve this. This is uncertainty, not proof the existing term is wrong.
Do not extend the uncertain technical preview noun into this failure status merely because existing crop wording uses it. Leave fallback until this lexical use is resolved.
